en.description:
Hexwall — the classic trap puzzle, built for Apple Watch.

Tap hexagons to build walls and box in the fox before it reaches the edge and escapes. Every move counts: think ahead, cut off its path, and trap it in the fewest taps — a clever battle of wits, now right on your wrist. No phone needed.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One-tap play — pure strategy, no reflex, no timing pressure
• Endless procedurally-generated boards — never the same twice
• Difficulty that scales as you get sharper
• Track your best (fewest taps to trap)
• Play fully offline, anytime — a quick brain teaser on your wrist
• Progress & stats saved automatically
• Built native for Apple Watch — no iPhone required

A glance at your wrist becomes a satisfying puzzle. Can you corner it every time?
en.releaseNotes:
The fox brought friends.

• NEW CRITTERS — meet the sly cat, who slinks around lazy walls, and the
  speedy hare, who hops twice every turn. Each one escapes its own way.
• DAILY CHALLENGE — one shared puzzle a day with a strict wall budget.
  Run out of walls, you lose. Build your streak!
• LIVING WORLDS — unlock new board themes with fireflies, falling snow,
  rising embers and starlight.
• STATS — wins, win rate, streaks, and perfect traps, all on your wrist.
• Celebrations, smoother animations, and a fresh look from launch to win.

Pure tap. Fully offline. No phone needed.
en.subtitle: Trap the runner on your Watch
